body.description: Smart Guitar body blank, Explorer-derived ergonomic solidbody. Official CAD length 468.5 mm, derived width 402.85 mm. Thickness 47.0 mm (see CONF-BODY-THICKNESS).

provenance.note: Thickness set to 47.0 mm on 2026-07-27. Enlarged from 44.45 to clear opposed-face web violations among spec-native cavities; 47.0 is the binding requirement from control_cavity (20) against bridge_pickup_route (19), and teensy_io_pocket (20) against neck_pickup_route (19), at min_web 8.0. Briefly held at 51.0 on the strength of an antenna recess that turned out not to be a body cavity at all.

standoff_mm is 6.0, NOT the 10.0 in the source. The source value was a stacking standoff for mounting this HAT on the Pi 5 header; under the ruled side-by-side layout it is floor-mounted like the Pi. Requires a ribbon or riser to the Pi 5 GPIO header rather than direct stacking.

provenance.note: Anisotropic margins are back-derived from the stated 70 x 25 mm pocket: 61 + 2x4.5 = 70 and 18 + 2x3.5 = 25. The source states a single margin of 4.5, which does not reproduce the stated width. lid_clearance 4.5 mm is the source's header_clearance_mm.

conflicts.ruling: Stated width 368.3 mm is the outlier and is treated as stale. Taking the official CAD length with the traced topology gives a single uniform scale k = 468.5/290.79 = 1.611128 and a derived width of 402.85 mm, against which the stated 368.3 mm is 34.55 mm (9.38%) short. The cross-check is decisive: trusting the stated width instead derives a body length of 428.32 mm, 40.18 mm short of the official CAD. Note also that 368.3, 444.5, and 438.15 are all exact round inch values (14.50, 17.50, 17.25) which read as assumptions, while 468.5 (18.44 in) is not and reads as measured. DERIVED WIDTH 402.85 mm IS A PREDICTION, not a measurement: it must be verified against a physical blank in SMART-GUITAR-PLAN-COLLISION-1 phase 1.

CONF-TRACE-REGISTRATION concerns void POSITIONS and does not impugn the silhouette aspect; the two are separable claims.

conflicts.ruling: SCOPE: this concerns the trace's internal VOID POSITIONS only. It does NOT impugn the traced silhouette's aspect ratio, which is independently corroborated under CONF-BODY-WIDTH. The two are separable: an AI render can place voids decoratively while the outline proportion it was traced from remains faithful. FINDING: the trace's V4 and V6 cannot be reconciled with the spec's cavity positions by any similarity transform. V4 sits higher than the spec expects while V6 sits lower — opposite directions, so no single scale or offset fits, and the X sign disagrees too. The trace's own provenance explains it: an AI render's voids are drawn, not dimensioned. CONSEQUENCE: the outline-to-spec frame transform is deterministic once body length is known and needs no landmarks, but V4 and V6 were the only landmarks available to VERIFY it, so that alignment stays unverified. Mitigation: use the trace for the body silhouette and the through-body voids V1, V2, V3, V5 only, and take every cavity position from the spec. Never read a cavity position out of the trace.

provenance.note: SMART-GUITAR-CAVITY-GEOMETRY-1. Dated read-only snapshot: values were copied here so the derivation stays reproducible if the source repositories change, which they are expected to.

notes: INTERNAL physical geometry record. Contains no cost, price, or manufacturing-time fields by design.

Every cavity dimension in the paired geometry record is DERIVED from this register. Nothing downstream reads a stated cavity dimension, which is why a stale note like 'total_height_mm: 76.0' cannot propagate.
stated_* fields exist only so the derivation can be compared against the source specs. They are never inputs.

The source scan behind this register was BOUNDED and is not exhaustive. It covered sg-spec, luthiers-toolbox instrument_geometry, and tap_tone_pi hardware docs. string_master_v.4.0 was not fully searched. Absence of a conflict record is not evidence that no conflict exists.

min_floor_mm is 8.0 on every cavity: an engineering estimate, not a structural calculation. The pod sits in the lower bout near the control cavity and the battery routing, so the real minimum should come from a structural review under string tension.
The derived pod footprint is a LOWER BOUND. The Hi-Z buffered splitter is required by the canonical signal chain and has no dimensions anywhere, so it could not be included.

This record derives cavity SIZE only. It does not validate cavity POSITION against the body outline, so it cannot detect two cavities colliding in plan or a cavity breaching the perimeter. Plan-level collision checking needs the traced outline and is out of scope. CONF-OPPOSED-FACE-WEB is a concrete instance of what that omission hides.

Pickups, pickup routes, the neck pocket, the bridge, the control cavity, and the output jack are NOT modelled here. This register covers the embedded-electronics cavities only: the pod, the Teensy pocket, and the battery chamber. Pickup disagreements are recorded as conflicts (CONF-PICKUP-TYPE, CONF-PICKUP-ROUTE-DIMS) but no pickup dimension is derived or fit-checked.

Because top-face routes are excluded, the derived body thickness is a LOWER BOUND in a second way: it accounts only for back-face cavity depth plus floor, never for a top-face route cutting toward the same plane from the other side.
